content:
Rules are essentially a series of if statements that Amazon Cognito evaluates sequentially. For
example, if a user's email address contains @corporate, Amazon Cognito assigns that user
Role_A. If a user's email address contains @subsidiary, it assigns that user Role_B. Otherwise, it
assigns the user the default authenticated role.
To learn more, see Using rule-based mapping to assign roles to users in the Amazon Cognito
Developer Guide.
